claim.claim-text: 1. A method for preparing a passivating contact structure, comprising:

2. The method according to claim 1, wherein before activating the dopant in the doped layer (320), the dopant concentration of regions of the doped layer (320) adjacent to the polysilicon layers (310) is smaller than the dopant concentration of a region of the doped layer (320) away from the polysilicon layers (310), and the dopant concentration of the regions of the doped layer (320) adjacent to the polysilicon layers (310) is greater than the dopant concentration of the polysilicon layers (310).

3. The method according to claim 2, wherein before activating the dopant in the doped layer (320), the dopant concentration of the doped layer (320) is symmetrically distributed from a central plane of the doped layer (320) to two sides of the doped layer (320) away from the central plane, and the distance between the central plane and one of the two sides of the doped layer (320) away from the substrate (10) is equal to the distance between the central plane and the other one of two sides of the doped layer (320) adjacent to the substrate (10).

4. The method according to claim 2, wherein the doped layer (320) comprises a plurality of first doped polysilicon layers (321, 322, 323, 324, 325), and the plurality of first doped polysilicon layers are stacked in a direction away from the tunnel layer (20).

5. The method according to claim 4, wherein the plurality of first doped polysilicon layers (321, 322, 323, 324, 325) are arranged symmetrically about a central plane of the doped layer (320), and the dopant in every two of the plurality of first doped polysilicon layers (321, 322, 323, 324, 325) that are symmetrically arranged is distributed symmetrically about the central plane, the distance between the central plane and one side of the doped layer (320) away from the substrate (10) is equal to the distance between the central plane and another side of the doped layer (320) adjacent to the substrate (10).

6. The method according to claim 2, wherein the doped layer (320) is a plurality of doped layers (320), on a condition that the plurality of doped layers (320) have the same dopant concentration, the thickness of the polysilicon layer (310) between two adjacent doped layers (320) is greater than each of the thickness of the polysilicon layer (310) which is also the innermost layer and the thickness of the polysilicon layer (310) which is also the outermost layer.

7. The method according to claim 1, wherein each of the polysilicon layers (310) comprises an intrinsic polysilicon layer or a second doped polysilicon layer, and the dopant concentration of the second doped polysilicon layer is smaller than the dopant concentration of the doped layer (320).

8. The method according to claim 7, wherein the innermost layer in the initial stack structure (30) is the second doped polysilicon layer, and the dopant concentration of a region of the innermost layer adjacent to the tunnel layer (20) is smaller than the dopant concentration of a region of the innermost layer away from the tunnel layer (20); or

the innermost layer in the initial stack structure (30) is the second doped polysilicon layer, and a dopant position in the innermost layer is spaced from a surface of the innermost layer adjacent to the tunnel layer (20); or the outermost layer in the initial stack structure (30) is the second doped polysilicon layer, and a dopant position in the outermost layer is spaced from a surface of the outermost layer away from the tunnel layer (20).

9. The method according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein a refractive index of the doped layer (320) is greater than a refractive index of the polysilicon layers (310); preferably, the refractive index of the doped layer (320) is in a range from 4.1 to 4.5, and the refractive index of the polysilicon layers (310) is in a range from 3.88 to 4.10.

10. The method according to any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the dopant concentration of the doped stack structure (40) is in a range from 1E20 toms/cm<3> to 8E20 toms/cm<3>, and a dopant concentration difference between any two regions in the doped stack structure (40) is less than or equal to 2E20 toms/cm<3>.
11. A passivating contact structure, prepared by the method according to any one of claims 1 to 10.
12. A solar cell, comprising:
a substrate (10); and a passivating contact structure according to claim 11, disposed on one side of the substrate (10).
13. The solar cell according to claim 12, further comprising:
14. A method for preparing a solar cell, comprising:
provide a substrate (10); forming a passivating contact structure on one side of the substrate (10) by the method according to any one of claims 1 to 13.

15. A photovoltaic device, comprising a cell group, wherein the cell group comprises one or more connected solar cells according to claim 12 or 13; or the cell group comprises one or more connected solar cells prepared by the method according to claim 14.
